newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar touch firmer but trade minimal.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar touch firmer but trade minimal.

text.p: Nearby August accounted for the bulk of the thin volume traded on London's white sugar futures market on Monday morning as players waited for the New York open to inspire activity.
August pushed gently higher on commission house buying to stand up 50 cents at $326.50 at 1055 GMT, partially offset by mixed sellers.
August/October was well supported at around $10.00, traders said. October was up 50 cents at $316.50 and volume reached a light 58 lots.
Technical analysts pegged August support at $325, followed by trendline support at around $323. On the upside, prices were expected to target $331 and thence $341, they said.
In Paris just 22 lots of August changed hands. The position was 50 cents higher at $326.50, the same as its London equivalent.
